_about: Public-domain James Oswald Dykes (1835-1912), Scottish Presbyterian minister of Regent Square, London, and principal of the English Presbyterian college, for the Word Hoard: his Sermon on the Mount trilogy (The Beatitudes of the Kingdom 1872, The Laws of the Kingdom 1873, The Relations of the Kingdom to the World 1874), From Jerusalem to Antioch (1874), The Manifesto of the King (1881), The Gospel according to St. Paul (1888), Plain Words on Great Themes (1892), The Law of the Ten Words (1900), The Christian Minister and his Duties (1909) and The Divine Worker in Creation and Providence (1909), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 49 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

dykes-beatitudes: The Beatitudes of the Kingdom (London : James Nisbet, 1872)
dykes-laws-of-kingdom: The laws of the Kingdom (New York : R. Carter, 1873)
dykes-relations-of-kingdom: The relations of the kingdom to the world (New York : R. Carter, 1874)
dykes-jerusalem-to-antioch: From Jerusalem to Antioch : sketches of the primitive church (London : Hodder and Stoughton, 1874)
dykes-manifesto-of-the-king: The manifesto of the king : an exposition of the Sermon on the Mount (London : J. Nisbet, 1881)
dykes-gospel-according-to-paul: The Gospel according to St. Paul : studies in the first eight chapters of his Epistle to the Romans (London : J. Nisbet, 1888)
dykes-plain-words: Plain words on great themes (London Sampson Low, Marston, 1892)
dykes-law-of-ten-words: The law of the ten words (New York, Hodder and Stoughton [etc., 1900)
dykes-christian-minister: The Christian minister and his duties (Edinburgh, T. & T. Clark, 1909)
dykes-divine-worker: The divine worker in creation and providence (Edinburgh : T. & T. Clark, 1909)
